subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: What session-scoped process-event contract should OpenClaw expose, and what authorization, redaction, replay, and retention boundaries must apply?
rationale: This cannot be safely implemented as a narrow bug fix because it defines a new core event contract and exposes intermediate run state across clients and sessions.

options.title: Design additive process events
options.body: Create a documented process/step contract with stable ids, bounded replay, permission checks, redaction, and mappings from existing streams.

options.title: Keep existing event families
options.body: Decline a new process taxonomy for now and document how clients should combine the current run/tool/item/session streams.

options.title: Narrow to local projection
options.body: Let clients or SDKs project existing events into process-like UI state without adding durable gateway replay semantics.

recommendation.title: Design additive process events
recommendation.body: Create a documented process/step contract with stable ids, bounded replay, permission checks, redaction, and mappings from existing streams.

likelyOwner.reason: The central event stream and structured item lifecycle history point to this owner as the best available decision router.
